relation_to_discovery: Outcome-informed 8-history stress screen (budget 0.25/0.5/1/8) and outcome-informed middle-range screen (budgets 2/3/4/5) motivated this independent-history confirmation. Those 8 histories are EXCLUDED. Freeze applies only to this new cohort, not the original scientific idea.
randomization: Each independent history uses identical original founder state within its near/far pre arms. At t400 sample the same 8 individual indices with a separate matched RNG across pre-history arms; the different inherited genotypes remain intact. After switch, common new visitor histories and common random numbers are matched across histories within setting/mode/destination/budget. No plant arrival.
estimand: For each visitor history and reproductive setting: sum occupancy indicators over 4 frozen budgets and 2 post destinations, divided by 8. Compute a far-pre minus near-pre difference under evolving assurance, and subtract the corresponding fixed-assurance difference. This is the matched difference in integrated persistence across the full fixed stress grid, not best-case survival at a selected budget.
frozen_primary_rule: Pooled over all four settings, the mean of the 32 visitor-history means for (evolving far-minus-near AUC) - (fixed far-minus-near AUC) must be > 0 and its 95% history-bootstrap lower bound > 0. No setting may be omitted. Four separate setting estimates and their 95% history-bootstrap intervals are mandatory secondary results regardless of sign.
admissibility: Require all 4096 post trajectories; missing/invalid case fails the test, extinct populations have zero occupancy but undefined trait endpoints. No survivor-only conditioning for persistence.
claim_limits: The stress grid was outcome-informed by previous exploratory work; this is an independent-new-randomization test of a narrowly targeted hypothesis, not a global universal model claim.
No direct experimental control of temporal-order trait shifts
No natural island calibration or ecological rescue rate
Post-switch n and density pollen transfer and ovule budget jointly change by construction
This tests effect of allowing assurance evolution over 400 prehistory updates, not the isolated causal contribution of assurance alleles
